page.overview:
Who is Gata's Mother?

Magician Queen|gender=Female|age=Unknown|species=Unknown|relatives=Gata (Daughter)|firstintroduced=Issue 49}}

An Unknown Magic User was once one of the great magician queens of Ooo. However, once coming upon magic from beyond reality, it corrupted her, and she would become banished to her own dimension.
